blurb: Guests rent kayaks powered by foot pedals or paddles and explore Lake Powell starting from Antelope Point Marina. The kayaks include single and double-seat Hobie Mirage Passports and traditional Ocean Kayaks. The average trip time is 5 to 6 hours, and guests must bring water and snacks as there are no rest areas on the water.
